items.title: Know, then Draw: A New Learning Paradigm for Visual Generation
items.title_zh: 了解，然后绘制：视觉生成的新学习范式
items.description: Visual generation requires both high-level semantic knowledge and fine-grained pixel details. We propose a learning paradigm that assigns these roles to autoregressive pretraining for knowledge acquisition and diffusion post-training for high-fidelity rendering. Within this framework, we study the objective, representation, and scaling of knowledge acquisition and rendering. Controlled comparisons identify autoregression as the stronger pretraining objective for downstream rendering, improving both learning efficiency and final generation quality. We further find that AR-only generation quality does not necessarily correlate with final performance; semantic quality matters more. This motivates a purely semantic tokenizer trained with language supervision alone, without an image decoder or reconstruction loss. We establish compute-optimal scaling laws for knowledge acquisition and rendering, and find that autoregressive pretraining lowers the fitted asymptotic rendering loss compared with pixel diffusion models trained from scratch. Guided by the laws, we train a 3B-parameter text-to-image model with only 6,600 H100 GPU-hours, achieving 86 on GenEval and 87 on DPG-Bench and validating the proposed paradigm at scale.
items.description_zh: 视觉生成需要高级语义知识和细粒度像素细节。我们提出了一种学习范式，将这些角色分配给用于知识获取的自回归预训练和用于高保真渲染的扩散后训练。在此框架内，我们研究知识获取和呈现的目标、表示和扩展。受控比较将自回归确定为下游渲染的更强预训练目标，从而提高学习效率和最终生成质量。我们进一步发现，仅 AR 的生成质量并不一定与最终性能相关；语义质量更重要。这激发了纯粹的语义标记器仅通过语言监督进行训练，没有图像解码器或重建损失。我们为知识获取和渲染建立了计算最优缩放法则，并发现与从头开始训练的像素扩散模型相比，自回归预训练降低了拟合渐近渲染损失。在这些定律的指导下，我们仅用 6,600 H100 GPU 小时训练了 3B 参数文本到图像模型，在 GenEval 上达到 86 小时，在 DPG-Bench 上达到 87 小时，并大规模验证了所提出的范例。
items.authors: Yucheng Mao, Chongjian Ge, Zhuowen Tu, Hao Tan, Hanwen Jiang

items.title: Instruction Capacity: Behavior and Degradation of Language Models under Controlled Load
items.title_zh: 指令能力：受控负载下语言模型的行为和退化
items.description: The quality with which language models follow instructions falls as the load grows, yet there is still no quantity that expresses the limit of a model in units of load with an uncertainty. We propose an instrument in which the load consists of rules that replace single-token words in a text without meaning: such an instruction is atomic, the rules are independent by the construction of the task, and the outcome of every application of a rule is determined by a computable reference answer. Every occurrence of a word to be replaced becomes a Bernoulli trial with a known position in the answer and a known rule number. The statistical model first measures the shape of the dependence of the probability of a right replacement on the text length, the word position, the replacement density, the number of rules and the rule number, then describes it by smooth laws and restores a reference level that does not depend on the choice of the coding. The model yields the instruction capacity - the number of rules held at a given share of right replacements - with an uncertainty. A measurement of GPT-4o mini (2958 requests, 642,430 trials) gave regular laws for every load factor and for the collapse of the answer; the instruction capacity was about 37-38 rules at a share of right replacements of 0.95, and about 18-19 rules at the full replacement density. The code of the instrument, the measurement data and the passport are open, and every number of the passport is recomputed from the published points. The passport of a model serves as the calibration of a future meter of the instruction load of prompts.
items.description_zh: 随着负载的增加，语言模型遵循指令的质量会下降，但仍然没有一个数量可以不确定地以负载为单位来表达模型的极限。我们提出了一种工具，其中负载由替换文本中无意义的单标记单词的规则组成：这样的指令是原子的，规则与任务的构造无关，并且规则的每个应用的结果都由可计算的参考答案确定。每次出现要替换的单词都会成为伯努利试验，其答案中的位置和规则编号已知。统计模型首先测量正确替换概率对文本长度、词位置、替换密度、规则数和规则数的依赖形状，然后用平滑法则描述它，并恢复一个不依赖于编码选择的参考水平。该模型产生的指令容量（在给定的正确替换比例下所保留的规则数量）具有不确定性。 GPT-4o mini 的测量（2958 个请求，642,430 次试验）为每个负载因子和答案的崩溃提供了规则的规律；当正确替换比例为 0.95 时，指令容量约为 37-38 条规则，而在完全替换密度下，指令容量约为 18-19 条规则。仪器的代码、测量数据和护照都是公开的，护照的每一个数字都是根据公布的点重新计算的。模型的护照可作为未来仪表提示指令负载的校准。

items.title: Evaluating DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 for loss of control and harmful manipulation risks
items.title_zh: 评估 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 的失控和有害操纵风险
items.description: As frontier language models grow increasingly capable and autonomous, independent third-party evaluations are critical for characterizing their systemic safety risks. While closed-source releases are routinely accompanied by comprehensive system cards, open-weight models receive less scrutiny regarding frontier risks. To address this gap, we present an independent safety evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the latest version of V4.1 Flash that departs from V4 with a new architecture, scaled-up training, and strong agentic capabilities. Drawing on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice, we evaluate the model across 34 benchmarks, including 5 in-house suites, spanning evaluation integrity, loss of control, and harmful manipulation. Conforming to the AEF-1 standard, we compare V4.1 Flash-1017 against V4.1 Flash, earlier DeepSeek V4 models, and leading closed-source systems (GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and Gemini 3.8 Flash). Overall, V4.1 Flash-1017 shows substantial safety improvements over the V4 generation and approaches or matches leading closed-source baselines on several dimensions, while still exhibiting notable behaviors that warrant continued attention. Building on our findings, we highlight three key observations and recommendations. First, because safety can shift and even regress across minor updates, developers should integrate safety evaluation into incremental releases. Second, as final-turn outputs and end-state checks alone cannot reliably detect loss-of-control behaviors, deployments require process-level observability across both reasoning traces and action logs. Third, because public benchmarks elicit strong evaluation awareness and face data contamination risks, developing private benchmarks is essential for trustworthy frontier evaluation.
items.description_zh: 随着前沿语言模型的能力和自主性不断增强，独立的第三方评估对于表征其系统安全风险至关重要。虽然闭源版本通常伴随着全面的系统卡，但开放权重模型在前沿风险方面受到的审查较少。为了弥补这一差距，我们对 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 进行了独立安全评估，这是 V4.1 Flash 的最新版本，它不同于 V4，具有新的架构、扩大的训练和强大的代理功能。我们借鉴欧盟通用人工智能实践守则，通过 34 个基准评估模型，其中包括 5 个内部套件，涵盖评估完整性、失控和有害操纵。根据 AEF-1 标准，我们将 V4.1 Flash-1017 与 V4.1 Flash、早期的 DeepSeek V4 模型以及领先的闭源系统（GPT-6 Astra、GPT-5.6 Sol 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash）进行比较。总体而言，V4.1 Flash-1017 比 V4 代显示出显着的安全改进，并在多个方面接近或匹配领先的闭源基线，同时仍然表现出值得持续关注的显着行为。根据我们的发现，我们强调了三项关键观察和建议。首先，��于安全性可能会因次要更新而发生变化甚至倒退，因此开发人员应将安全评估集成到增量版本中。其次，由于仅最终回合输出和最终状态检查无法可靠地检测失控行为，因此部署需要跨推理跟踪和操作日志的流程级可观察性。第三，由于公共基准会引发强烈的评估意识并面临数据污染风险，因此开发私人基准对于值得信赖的前沿评估至关重要。
items.authors: Yao Huang, Zhiyuan Zeng, Yu Wang, Zhitong Zhu, Dingcheng Duan, Hao Li, Shangzhi Xu, Yifan Wang, Jinzhe Tu, Shukun Xiong, Yihe Zang, Han Yan, Hongchang Yang, Fuyu Gu, Wei Xu, Yinpeng Dong, Xiaojian Li

items.title: Amortizing Sequential Experimental Design in Reasoning LLMs
items.title_zh: 推理LLM中的摊销序贯实验设计
items.description: Despite their extensive pretraining knowledge and strong reasoning capabilities, large language models (LLMs) struggle to adaptively gather information in experimental design tasks. We study how to amortize sequential Bayesian experimental design (BED) into an LLM by explicitly training the reasoning that guides action selection using information-gain rewards. Our approach specifies the experimental generative model independently of the LLM's own beliefs, allowing us to optimize expected information gain under a model of our choosing. We investigate the design choices for amortization, including alternative generative-model constructions, reward estimation, hypothesis-space specification, multi-step objectives, and computational costs relative to training- and inference-time BED baselines. On Twenty Questions, the resulting policies improve information acquisition and task performance, outperform inference- and training-time BED baselines at substantially lower computational cost, and generalize to unseen categories. We further demonstrate positive transfer from Twenty Questions training to Medi-Q, a real-world clinical dialogue benchmark. These results suggest that information gathering can be learned as a generalizable reasoning skill in LLMs.
items.description_zh: 尽管大型语言模型（LLM）拥有广泛的预训练知识和强大的推理能力，但它们仍难以在实验设计任务中自适应地收集信息。我们研究如何通过明确训练使用信息增益奖励指导行动选择的推理，将顺序贝叶斯实验设计（BED）摊销到LLM中。我们的方法指定独立于LLM自己的信念的实验生成模型，使我们能够在我们选择的模型下优化预期信息增益。我们研究了摊销的设计选择，包括替代生成模型结构、奖励估计、假设空间规范、多步骤目标以及相对于训练和推理时间 BED 基线的计算成本。在“二十个问题”中，由此产生的策略改善了信息获取和任务性能，以低得多的计算成本超越推理和训练时间 BED 基线，并推广到看不见的类别。我们进一步证明了从“二十个问题”培训到 Medi-Q（现实世界临床对话基准）的积极转变。这些结果表明，信息收集可以作为LLM的通用推理技能来学习。
items.authors: Anita Kriz, Antonin Berthon, Nicolás Astorga, Mihaela van der Schaar

items.title: RealCLI: Toward a Unified Evaluation of Human-Agent Collaboration for CLI Agents
items.title_zh: RealCLI：对 CLI 代理的人机协作进行统一评估
items.description: Command-line interface (CLI) agents increasingly execute longer-horizon tasks, yet existing benchmarks either assume that user instructions remain fixed throughout execution or evaluate task outcomes without capturing runtime collaboration quality. In this paper, we present REALCLI, a paired benchmark that unifies the evaluation of task execution and human-agent collaboration quality on realistic CLI tasks. To comprehensively measure collaboration, REALCLI builds a five-dimensional framework, operationalized into 22 sub-dimensions and 51 interaction scenario templates. REALCLI provides two modes for paired comparison: REALCLI-EXEC supplies complete specifications upfront, whereas REALCLI-COLLAB introduces a scripted user that delivers progressive information, corrections, constraint revisions, and authorization decisions. Evaluations reveal profound capability gaps in frontier agents: the best configuration attains an average score of only 49.2%, and when evaluated by the joint collaboration score (J_{collab}), the peak performance reaches merely 37.6%. These results show that task effectiveness diverges sharply from collaboration quality, with models consistently struggling in steerability, trust calibration, and safety boundary management. REALCLI provides a rigorous, reproducible foundation for measuring and advancing collaborative CLI agents.
items.description_zh: 命令行界面 (CLI) 代理越来越多地执行长期任务，但现有基准要么假设用户指令在整个执行过程中保持固定，要么在不捕获运行时协作质量的情况下评估任务结果。在本文中，我们提出了 REACLI，这是一个配对基准，它统一了对实际 CLI 任务的任务执行和人机协作质量的评估。为了全面衡量协作，REALCLI构建了一个五维框架，可操作为22个子维度和51个交互场景模板。 REALCLLI 提供两种配对比较模式：REALCLI-EXEC 预先提供完整的规范，而 REALCLLI-COLLAB 引入了脚本化用户，可提供渐进式信息、更正、约束修订和授权决策。评估揭示了前沿智能体的巨大能力差距：最佳配置的平均得分仅为49.2%，而通过联合协作得分（J_{collab}）评估时，峰值性能仅达到37.6%。这些结果表明，任务有效性与协作质量存在很大差异，模型在可操纵性、信任校准和安全边界管理方面始终陷入困境。 REACLI 为测量和推进协作 CLI 代理提供了严格的、可重复的基础。
items.authors: Yunqi Liu, Peiyu Wang, Bingli Wang, Leo Luo, Xuanwu Song, Xudong Ma, Hongxin Li, Yaxin Du, Weicheng Gu, Fanglin Xu, Yi Xing, XiangLong Liu, Jujie He, Zhange Zhang, Huatong Song, Zhaoyi Li, Deyang Kong, Chuan Hao, Peihao Wu, Mingjie Tang, Ran Tao, Jian Yang, Wayne Xin Zhao, Bryan Dai

items.title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
items.title_zh: LongZero：从零数据增强LLM的长上下文推理
items.description: Reinforcement learning (RL) is an effective way to strengthen the long-context reasoning of large language models (LLMs), but it needs training data that are long, diverse, challenging, and verifiable. Human annotation of such data is expensive, naturally occurring data are too scarce to sustain RL, and existing synthesis methods depend on external corpora or stronger teacher models, which become harder to obtain as the trained models get stronger. Recently, RL from zero data, in which a model learns from tasks it proposes itself, has achieved excellent performance, but existing methods target short-context tasks. Therefore, we propose LongZero, a method that lets an LLM improve its own long-context reasoning without any external data. Instead of writing questions and answers over existing documents, LongZero first has the model synthesize the question and answer with its supporting evidence in a compact structured form, and only then separately expands the evidence into a long multi-document context. LongZero combines these self-written multi-hop reasoning tasks with self-written multi-round retrieval tasks and trains the model with GRPO. We evaluate LongZero on two LLMs across five long-context reasoning benchmarks and compare it with RL on data synthesized from external corpora. Experimental results show that LongZero can generalize to real tasks, and outperforms both baselines, suggesting a viable and promising path to improving long-context reasoning of LLMs.
items.description_zh: 强化学习（RL）是强化大型语言模型（LLM）长上下文推理的有效方法，但它需要长、多样化、具有挑战性和可验证的训练数据。此类数据的人工注释成本高昂，自然发生的数据太稀缺而无法维持强化学习，现有的合成方法依赖于外部语料库或更强大的教师模型，而随着训练模型变得更强，这些模型变得更难获得。最近，从零数据开始的强化学习，其中模型从它自己提出的任务中学习，已经取得了优异的性能，但现有的方法针对的是短上下文任务。��此，我们提出了LongZero，一种让LLM无需任何外部数据即可改进其自身长上下文推理的方法。 LongZero 不是在现有文档上编写问题和答案，而是首先让模型以紧凑的结构化形式综合问题和答案及其支持证据，然后才将证据单独扩展为长的多文档上下文。 LongZero将这些自写的多跳推理任务与自写的多轮检索任务结合起来，并使用GRPO训练模型。我们在五个长上下文推理基准的两个LLM上评估了 LongZero，并将其与从外部语料库合成的数据上的强化学习进行了比较。实验结果表明，LongZero 可以推广到实际任务，并且优于两个基线，这为改进LLM的长上下文推理提供了一条可行且有前途的途径。

items.title: TauIndianBankBench: Procedure-Aware, Action-Oriented Evaluation of Tool-Using Conversational Agents
items.title_zh: TauIndianBankBench：对使用工具的会话代理进行程序感知、面向行动的评估
items.description: Many Indian banks serve customers through FAQ pages and scripted chatbots. Assistants based on language models could respond faster and carry out requests such as blocking a card, but only if they give correct information and follow the bank's rules. These rules prescribe a procedure, a set of required steps, such as obtaining a closure quote before closing a deposit. Adapting models to this domain requires measuring how well they follow the procedure, before and after training. Benchmarks usually judge only the records left at the end of a conversation. Many required steps, however, leave the records unchanged, so an assistant that skips them can still be judged successful. We present TauIndianBankBench, an action-oriented benchmark of 1,000 Indian retail-banking tasks where an assistant helps a simulated customer. Besides the final records, it checks that the assistant took every required step and made no unrequested change. For every model, 6.5-12.0% of sessions are judged successful when only the final records are checked, although the assistant skipped a required step or made an unrequested change. Scoring both procedure and outcome shows more accurately how well language models perform in Indian retail banking.
items.description_zh: 许多印度银行通过常见问题解答页面和脚本化聊天机器人为客户提供服务。基于语言模型的助手可以更快地响应并执行诸如阻止银行卡之类的请求，但前提是他们提供正确的信息并遵守银行的规则。这些规则规定了一个程序，一组必需的步骤，例如在关闭存款之前获取关闭报价。使模型适应该领域需要测量它们在训练之前和之后遵循程序的情况。基准通常只判断对话结束时留下的记录。然而，许多必需的步骤不会使记录保持不变，因此跳过这些步骤的助手仍然可以被判断为成功。我们推出了 TauIndianBankBench，这是一个以行动为导向的基准，包含 1,000 项印度零售银行任务，其中助理会帮助模拟客户。除了最终记录之外，它还会检查助理是否采取了所有必要的步骤，并且没有进行未经请求的更改。对于每个模型，仅检查最终记录时，尽管助理跳过了必需的步骤或进行了未经请求的更改，但仍有 6.5-12.0% 的会话被判定为成功。对程序和结果进行评分可以更准确地显示语言模型在印度零售银行业务中的表现。

items.title: CausGround: Causal Interaction Grounding for Adaptive Embodied Planning
items.title_zh: CausGround：自适应具体化规划的因果交互基础
items.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.
items.description_zh: 多模态大语言模型 (MLLM) 显示出有前景的推理能力，但可靠的物理交互需要进行规划，以考虑操作何时可执行以及它们如何改变世界。这些先决条件和影响取决于环境，并且通常无法被 MLLM 捕获，因此适应具有挑战性。然而，现有方法要么需要昂贵的特定环境培训，要么依赖难以重用的非结构化交互体验。因此，我们引入了 CausGround，一种非参数因果交互基础框架，它将交互经验提炼为可重用的以行动为中心的因果知识。 CausGround 识别动作的先决条件和效果，并将它们组织在捕获对象属性和对象间关系的因子化世界状态表示中。在规划时，与任务相关的因果依赖性以当前观察为基础，以支持对先决条件的后向推理和对行动选择和多步骤规划的效果的前向推理。我们在模拟高级规划、交互推理和现实世界机器人操作方面评估 CausGround。在调整后的 VirtualHome 和 RoboCasa 基准上，CausGround 改进了跨 MLLM 主干的基于视觉的高级规划，将 VirtualHome 的平均任务成功率从 24.9% 提高到 53.3%，将 RoboCasa ��闭环规划成功率从 43.0% 提高到 57.0%。在 SWITCH 上，平均交互推理准确度从 25.8% 增加到 31.9%，这表明动作选择、恢复和验证得到了改进。此外，现实世界的实验表明，CausGround 从 MLLM 解释的目标向后推理，得出可执行的高级操作序列以进行顺序操作。这些结果表明，可重用的动作先决条件和效果支持跨不同环境的长期具体规划，而无需参数更新。
items.authors: Yijun Shen, Diqi He, Jinbang Guo, Wanyue Zhang, Jiaming Mi, Huan Yang, Zhongyuan Wang, Zhiwei Yu, Kai Zhang

items.title: HuGe: Scaling Humanoid Generalist Vision-Language-Action Models with Egocentric Experience
items.title_zh: HuGe：以自我为中心的体验扩展人形通才视觉-语言-动作模型
items.description: Extending Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) to humanoid robots requires coordinated whole-body control and diverse demonstrations that are costly to collect in real-world scenarios. Although egocentric human demonstrations provide a complementary source of task experience, differences in visual embodiment and missing robot proprioception complicate transfer to humanoid policies. To address these challenges, we introduce HuGe, a family of Humanoid Generalist VLAs pre-trained on over 2,000 hours of egocentric human and robot data. Specifically, HuGe employs three existing representative VLA architectures to predict latent motion tokens for a pretrained whole-body controller, together with hand-control signals. Based on this, we introduce a three-stage training pipeline that combines egocentric pre-training, humanoid adaptation, and downstream fine-tuning. To facilitate transfer across embodiments, we construct pseudo-proprioceptive states through simulation playback during pre-training and modify arm appearance in egocentric observations through re-rendering during downstream fine-tuning. With this pipeline, HuGe achieves the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmark HumanoidArena. Furthermore, real-world experiments on the Unitree G1 indicate that augmenting robot demonstrations with visually adapted egocentric demonstrations significantly increases success on a pick-and-drop task.
items.description_zh: 将视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）扩展到人形机器人需要协调的全身控制和多样化的演示，而在现实场景中收集这些模型的成本很高。尽管以自我为中心的人类演示提供了任务经验的补充来源，但视觉体现的差异和机器人本体感觉的缺失使向人形策略的转移变得复杂。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了 HuGe，这是一个人形通才 VLA 系列，经过 2,000 多个小时的以自我为中心的人类和机器人数据的预训练。具体来说，HuGe 采用三种现有的代表性 VLA 架构来预测预训练全身控制器的潜在运动标记以及手控制信号。在此基础上，我们引入了一个三阶段的训练流程，结合了以自我为中心的预训练、人形适应和下游微调。为了促进跨实施例的转移，我们通过预训练期间的模拟回放构建伪本体感受状态，并通过下游微调期间的重新渲染来修改以自我为中心的观察中的手臂外观。通过这条管道，HuGe 在模拟基准 HumanoidArena 上实现了最先进的水平。此外，Unitree G1 上的实际实验表明，通过视觉适应的自我中心演示来增强机器人演示可以显着提高拾取任务的成功率。
items.authors: Yang Liu, Jiacheng Liu, Hengtao Li, Yuheng Huang, Zijian Yang, Ji Dai, Maoxin Wang, Yi Gao, Qishen Wang, Baohua Yin, Peiyang Li, Shuanghao Bai, Mingyang Sun, Pengxiang Ding, Jianqin Yin, Lixin Yang, Donglin Wang

items.title: OmniSpectra: A Unified Foundation Model for Universal Spectra Representation Learning
items.title_zh: OmniSpectra：通用光谱表示学习的统一基础模型
items.description: Standard sequence models encode position by token rank rather than physical coordinate, typically forcing practitioners to destructively resample continuous physical signals such as spectra observed across heterogeneous instruments. We identify this coordinate mismatch as a structural limitation in cross-instrument representation learning, and propose OmniSpectra, a wavelength-native foundation model for spectral representation learning: a continuous-coordinate masked autoencoder that discards the integer pixel indexing of sequence modeling. Mapping physical coordinates to a logarithmic basis turns the multiplicative scaling induced by cosmological redshift into a uniform additive shift. In continuous rotary position embeddings, this shared shift cancels from relative token distances rather than producing grid-dependent positional distortion. We further counter the spectral bias inherent to implicit neural decoders with a physics-grounded, resolution-gated Fourier decoder that provides anti-aliasing. Pretrained on eight surveys and benchmarked against seven baselines, our model reaches state-of-the-art performance with only 12.2M parameters while outperforming substantially larger models, indicating that encoding physical structure can substitute for parameter scale.
items.description_zh: 标准序列模型通过标记等级而不是物理坐标对位置进行编码，通常迫使从业者破坏性地重新采样连续的物理信号，例如在异构仪器上观察到的光谱。我们将这种坐标不匹配确定为跨仪器表示学习中的结构限制，并提出了 OmniSpectra，一种用于光谱表示学习的波长本机基础模型：一种连续坐标掩码自动编码器，它丢弃序列建模的整数像素索引。将物理坐标映射到对数基础将宇宙学红移引起的乘法标度转变为均匀的加法位移。在连续旋转位置嵌入中，这种共享移位抵消了相对标记距离，而不是产生依赖于网格的位置失真。我们使用基于物理的分辨率门控傅里叶解码器来进一步对抗隐式神经解码器固有的频谱偏差，该解码器提供抗锯齿功能。经过八项调查的预训练并针对七个基线进行基准测试，我们的模型仅用 1220 万个参数就达到了最先进的性能，同时优于更大的模型，这表明编码物理结构可以替代参数规模。
items.authors: Md Khairul Islam, Zeyu Xia, Adam S. Bolton, Judy Fox

items.title: Sensorimotor Alignment: A Platonic Proxy for Embodied Policy Success
items.title_zh: 感觉运动协调：具体政策成功的柏拉图式代理
items.description: Robot foundation models are typically evaluated through costly closed-loop rollouts, motivating low-cost offline proxies for model capability. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) suggests that as representations improve, modalities such as vision and language converge toward a shared statistical model of reality. We ask whether motion trajectories form another such modality: as embodied models become more capable, should their sensory representations converge toward the structure of physical motion? To test this, we propose Sensorimotor Alignment (S^2), a training-free offline metric that measures how well a model's sensory representation aligns with the geometry of physical motion. We find that S^2 correlates positively with downstream robot task success across model families, making it a low-cost offline proxy for prioritizing models before closed-loop evaluation. S^2 can also identify promising vision-language model (VLM) backbones before costly fine-tuning into vision-language-action models (VLAs). Beyond this correlation, S^2 offers representation-level explanations for phenomena observed in VLAs and world action models (WAMs). With S^2, we extend PRH to robotics and make sensorimotor alignment measurable, offering a low-cost, representation-level view of robot foundation models that closed-loop success rates alone cannot reveal.
items.description_zh: 机器人基础模型通常通过成本高昂的闭环部署进行评估，从而激发模型功能的低成本离线代理。柏拉图表征假说（PRH）表明，随着表征的改进，视觉和语言等模态会趋向于共享的现实统计模型。我们问运动轨迹是否形成了另一种这样的模态：随着具体模型变得更加强大，它们的感官表征是否应该向物理运动的结构收敛？为了测试这一点，我们提出了感觉运动对齐（S^2），这是一种无需训练的离线指标，用于测量模型的感觉表征与物理运动的几何形状的对齐程度。我们发现 S^2 与跨模型系列的下游机器人任务成功呈正相关，使其成为在闭环评估之前对模型进行优先级排序的低成本离线代理。 S^2 还可以在对视觉语言动作模型 (VLA) 进行昂贵的微调之前识别有前景的视觉语言模型 (VLM) 主干。除了这种相关性之外，S^2 还为 VLA 和世界行动模型 (WAM) 中观察到的现象提供表征级别的解释。借助 S^2，我们将 PRH 扩展到机器人领域，并使感觉运动对准可测量，从而提供机器人基础模型的低成本、代表��级别的视图，而仅靠闭环成功率无法揭示这一点。
items.authors: Yunfei Xie, Howard H. Qian, Shiyi Lan, Kaiyu Hang, Chen Wei

items.title: TAO: Tool-Aware Joint Scheduling for LLM-Based Agentic Serving
items.title_zh: TAO：基于 LLM 的代理服务的工具感知联合调度
items.description: Agentic services alternate between model inference on clustered GPUs and external tools on distributed CPUs. In this scenario, existing systems (1) overlook tool-return readiness in service evaluation, wasting limited resources, and (2) use heuristic strategies to decide admission and placement on GPUs, resulting in suboptimal scheduling decisions. To bridge this gap, we present TAO, a tool-aware joint scheduling framework for LLM-based agentic serving. Its value interface combines near-term tool readiness, node-specific cache credit with time-aware decay, and token footprint; a dynamic program jointly selects and places waiting sessions under capacity constraints. Across the 12 reported model-workload-concurrency settings, TAO reduces latency by up to 26.8%, reduces mean time to first token (TTFT) by up to 36.3%, and increases decode throughput by up to 29.5% relative to the best evaluated state-of-the-art baseline for each metric.
items.description_zh: 代理服务在集群 GPU 上的模型推理和分布式 CPU 上的外部工具之间交替。在这种情况下，现有系统 (1) 忽视了服务评估中的工具返回准备情况，浪费了有限的资源；(2) 使用启发式策略来决定 GPU 上的准入​​和放置，导致调度决策不理想。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 TAO，一种用于基于 LLM 的代理服务的工具感知联合调度框架。它的价值接口结合了近期工具准备情况、具有时间感知衰减的节点特定缓存信用以及代币足迹；一个动态程序联合选择等待时段并将其置于容量限制之下。在报告的 12 个模型-工作负载-并发设置中，相对于每个指标的最佳评估最先进基准，TAO 将延迟减少了高达 26.8%，将首次令牌的平均时间 (TTFT) 减少了高达 36.3%，并将解码吞吐量提高了高达 29.5%。
items.authors: Shuhuai Li, Shengdong Ye, Dongdong Ge, Yinyu Ye, Jianghao Lin

items.title: OmniShowcase: Omnidirectional Subject-Consistent Video Generation from Multi-View Images
items.title_zh: OmniShowcase：从多视图图像生成全向主题一致的视频
items.description: Generating videos of a specific subject from a few reference images remains challenging when the camera reveals surfaces that are not visible in the input. Early subject-to-video (S2V) methods condition on a single reference image and must therefore infer the subject's unseen appearance and geometry as the viewpoint changes. To address this limitation, recent methods extend S2V to multiple reference views, providing more information about the subject from different viewpoints. However, they do not explicitly specify the 3D structure that connects these observations. In addition, existing training data do not guarantee that viewpoint changes preserve the same underlying 3D subject. We present OmniShowcase, built on two components: (i) a fully automated data synthesis pipeline that produces training videos along diverse camera trajectories, with viewpoint variation driven by underlying subject geometry, even spanning full 360-degree orbits; and (ii) a geometry-conditioning method that provides the video model with a turntable of surface-normal maps reconstructed from the reference views without requiring temporal alignment with the generated frames. We construct Showcase-4K, a corpus of 3D-asset-based videos covering twelve camera motions across 88 trajectory configurations with reconstruction-derived surface-normal conditioning, and ShowcaseBench, a held-out evaluation set with the source meshes and camera parameters used to render each video. Experiments show state-of-the-art subject identity and 3D consistency while maintaining competitive video quality and motion. Project page: justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase
items.description_zh: 当相机显示输入中不可见的表面时，从一些参考图像生成特定主题的视频仍然具有挑战性。早期的主题到视频 (S2V) 方法以单个参考图像为条件，因此必须随着视点的变化推断主题不可见的外观和几何形状。为了解决这一限制，最近的方法将 S2V 扩展到多个参考视图，从不同的角度提供有关主题的更多信息。然而，他们没有明确指定连接这些观察结果的 3D 结构。此外，现有的训练数据并不能保证视点变化保留相同���底层 3D 主题。我们推出的 OmniShowcase 构建于两个组件之上：(i) 完全自动化的数据合成管道，可沿着不同的摄像机轨迹生成训练视频，视点变化由基础主体几何形状驱动，甚至跨越完整的 360 度轨道； (ii) 一种几何调节方法，为视频模型提供从参考视图重建的表面法线图转盘，而不需要与生成的帧进行时间对齐。我们构建了 Showcase-4K，一个基于 3D 资产的视频语料库，涵盖 88 个轨迹配置中的 12 个摄像机运动，并具有重建导出的表面法线条件；以及 ShowcaseBench，一个保留的评估集，其中包含用于渲染每个视频的源网格和摄像机参数。实验显示了最先进的主体身份和 3D 一致性，同时保持有竞争力的视频质量和运动。项目页面：justin4ai.github.io/OmniShowcase
items.authors: Junyeong Ahn, Geonwoo Kim, Kinam Kim, Gihwi Kim, Hoonjin Jung, Hyojin Jang, Jaegul Choo

items.title: Efficient Streaming Audio-Visual Target Speaker Extraction for Real-World Acoustic Scenes
items.title_zh: 针对真实世界声学场景的高效流媒体视听目标说话人提取
items.description: Streaming audio-visual target speaker extraction (AVTSE) is essential for latency-sensitive applications. However, current causal systems face two coupled gaps. First, standard benchmarks fix the number of speakers at two and ignore the near-/far-field interference, reverberation, and sudden noise of real scenes. Second, high-performance causal architectures are too heavy for edge deployment. Lightweight alternatives try to reclaim capacity by repeatedly invoking a small separator, which offsets the savings. To address the first gap, we release RealSSA, a realistic AVTSE benchmark consisting of RealSSA-Sim and RealSSA-Real. RealSSA-Sim provides controllable simulated scenes with 1--5 dynamic near-field interfering speakers; scenes with far-field interference additionally include 10--15 far-field interfering speakers. RealSSA-Real provides a held-out real-recorded evaluation set. To address the second gap, we propose Falcon, a causal AVTSE method. Its Separator performs multi-scale time-frequency separation in a single encoder--decoder pass. We train Falcon with an encoder-space speaker contrastive loss. This loss suppresses near-field leakage at zero inference cost and transfers across backbones. Falcon achieves state-of-the-art extraction quality on RealSSA-Sim, LRS2-2Mix, LRS3-2Mix, and VoxCeleb2-2Mix. Compared with the causal AV-TFGridNet baseline, it cuts parameters by 91.9%, computation by 20.2 times, and GPU inference latency by 11.1 times. Code and demo are available at https://cslikai.cn/Falcon/.
items.description_zh: 流式视听目标说话人提取 (AVTSE) 对于延迟敏感的应用程序至关重要。然而，当前的因果系统面临两个耦合的差距。首先，标准基准将扬声器数量固定为两个，并忽略真实场景的近/远场干扰、混响和突发噪声。其次，高性能因果架构对于边缘部署来说太重了。轻量级替代方案尝试通过重复调用小型分离器来回收容量，从而抵消了节省的费用。为了解决第一个差距，我们发布了 RealSSA，这是一个由 RealSSA-Sim 和 RealSSA-Real 组成的现实 AVTSE 基准测试。 RealSSA-Sim提供可控模拟场景，具有1--5个动态近场干扰扬声器；有远场干扰的场景还包括10--15个远场干扰扬声器。 RealSSA-Real 提供了保留的真实记录评估集。为了解决第二个差距，我们提出了 Falcon，一种因果 AVTSE 方法。其分离器在单个编码器-解码器通道中执行多尺度时频分离。我们使用编码器空间说话人对比损失来训练 Falcon。这种损失以零推理成本抑制近场泄漏并跨主干网传输。 Falcon 在 RealSSA-Sim、LRS2-2Mix、LRS3-2Mix 和 VoxCeleb2-2Mix 上实现了最先进的提取质量。与因果AV-TFGridNet基线相比，参数减少了91.9%，计算量减少了20.2倍，GPU推理延迟减少了11.1倍。代码和demo可在https://cslikai.cn/Falcon/获取。
items.authors: Wendi Sang, Kai Li, Yifan Li, Jianqiang Huang, Xiaolin Hu

items.title: AdaPRA: Process Reward Agents with Adaptive Rubrics for Data Science
items.title_zh: AdaPRA：采用数据科学自适应标准的流程奖励代理
items.description: Data science agents can automate end-to-end machine learning workflows, yet they remain far from competitive on human leaderboards. Agents make process errors such as insufficient exploration, unsound validation, coding bugs, and poor use of a fixed budget (re-running the same exploratory data analysis and baseline models in every attempt). We propose AdaPRA to address these issues: a persistent coding agent harness that accumulates knowledge across attempts on the same task, with rubric-guided process supervision that identifies and corrects errors. Our process reward agent audits the agent's trajectory and workspace by executing checks, and adapts its rubrics to each task. We find that rubrics seeded from easier tasks generalize to harder tasks, with rubric adaptation further improving performance. With five attempts per task, AdaPRA improves an 80B Qwen model's leaderboard percentile by 24.5 points on DSPredict-Easy and 14.8 points on DSPredict-Hard while reducing process errors. We also show that supervision with rubrics mined from one base model's runs improves another (DeepSeek-V3.2), and that AdaPRA beats DataPRM, a competitive PRM for data science. We also share our code for reproducibility.
items.description_zh: 数据科学代理可以自动化端到端机器学习工作流程，但它们在人类排行榜上仍远未具有竞争力。代理会犯一些流程错误，例如探索不足、验证不健全、编码错误以及固定预算使用不当（每次尝试都重新运行相同的探索性数据分析和基线模型）。我们建议 AdaPRA 来解决这些问题：一种持久的编码代理工具，可以在同一任务的尝试中积累知识，并通过规则引导的流程监督来识别和纠正错误。我们的流程奖励代理通过执行检查来审核代理的轨迹和工作空间，并根据每个任务调整其规则。我们发现，从较简单的任务中得出的评分标准可以推广到较困难的任务，并且评分标准的适应进一步提高了绩效。每个任务尝试五次后，AdaPRA 将 80B Qwen 模型的排行榜百分位数在 DSPredict-Easy 上提高了 24.5 分，在 DSPredict-Hard 上提高了 14.8 分，同时减少了过程错误。我们还表明，对从一个基本模型的运行中挖掘的规则进行监督可以改善另一个基本模型（DeepSeek-V3.2），并且 AdaPRA 击败了 DataPRM（数据科学领域的一种有竞争力的 PRM）。我们还共享我们的可重复性代码。
items.authors: Atharva Naik, Vivek Chari, Pol Llado, Daniel Fried, Carolyn Rosé, Benjamin Van Durme, Sam Thomson, Justin Svegliato
